Name: Zuriel, Son of Abihail
Summary: Zuriel, son of Abihail, was the chief of the Merarites, the Levites who carried the tabernacle's frames, bars, and pillars.
KeyStory: Zuriel oversaw the Merarite families in their heavy, unseen service of the tabernacle.
RelatedPeople: Abihail, Father of Zuriel; Moses; Merari
LifeLesson: The heaviest work of worship is often done by hands nobody applauds.
